# tenzir_workspace (Data Source)

A workspace, looked up by ID or slug. Needs `Workspace.read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_workspace" "default" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
  slug            = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization that owns the workspace.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The workspace ID. Set this or `slug`.
- `slug` (String) The workspace's name in URLs. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `icon_url` (String) The URL of the workspace icon.
- `name` (String) The display name.
